description: Gemini decan 2 (May 31 to June 10): personality, love, work and growth, with Venus as sub-ruler of the second ten degrees of Gemini.
answer: In Western astrology, the second decan of Gemini covers 10° to 19° of the sign, roughly May 31 to June 10, with Venus as its sub-ruler beside Mercury. It is read as airy wit softened by venusian charm and social grace. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Gemini decan 2 personality
paragraphs: From 10 to 19 degrees, Gemini takes Venus as sub-ruler, the planet linked with Libra. The Twins' curiosity remains, but it turns towards people, harmony and beauty. Second-decan Geminis are often described as natural diplomats, able to read a room and find the phrase that lets everyone relax. Their conversation tends to be gracious as well as quick, with a talent for making strangers feel included. Many have an eye for style, whether in clothing, design or the turn of a sentence, and they often enjoy art, music and lively company. A party, to them, is less a crowd than a set of small conversations waiting to be connected.

Venus brings a relational focus that can make this decan more partnership-minded than the restless first. These natives often think best in dialogue and may feel oddly flat working alone for too long. The Libran undertone also brings a dislike of conflict; they may smooth things over before the real issue has been aired. Indecision can appear when every option has merit and someone might be disappointed. Traditional texts associate this decan with ornament and pleasant speech. In everyday life, it frequently shows up as a person who makes connection feel effortless and elegant for others. Introductions are one of their quiet talents.

sections.heading: Gemini decan 2 in love and at work
paragraphs: Romance suits the second-decan Gemini well. They are often flirtatious, attentive and generous with compliments, and they tend to value partnership as a meeting of minds and manners. Shared culture, such as films, books and dinners with friends, helps relationships thrive. They need conversation and variety, but they also seek balance and fairness. The challenge is voicing displeasure directly rather than hoping a partner will guess. Honest, kind disagreement tends to strengthen these unions, because it gives their natural diplomacy something real to work with.

Professionally, this decan often excels in roles where people skills and communication meet. Public relations, design, event planning, client relations, mediation, fashion, hospitality and the arts can all appeal. They tend to be persuasive without being pushy and are good at building networks. Collaborative teams usually suit them better than isolated work. Their risk is overcommitting socially or avoiding the unpopular decision. Developing comfort with saying no, and with delivering tough feedback gracefully, can turn their charm into genuine leadership that others trust.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Gemini decan 2: what Venus adds
paragraphs: The second decan covers 10° to 19° of Gemini, which in most years means birthdays from May 31 to June 10. Its sub-ruler, Venus, comes from Libra, the next air sign after Gemini, so this decan borrows a little of Libra's character while staying Gemini at heart. The other two decans of Gemini belong to Mercury (decan 1) and Uranus (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Venus contributes charm, taste and a pull towards harmony. Its decans tend to be pictured as more sociable and aesthetic, alert to beauty and fairness, and keen to soften conflict through diplomacy, pleasure and good company. Venusian decans are often linked with art, hospitality, partnership and style, and their usual lesson is to say what they want rather than smooth it over. Set against Gemini's curiosity, wit, adaptability and a quick, talkative mind, that Venus note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Gemini decan 2
paragraphs: Growth for second-decan Geminis often centres on directness. Try stating a preference first in small matters, such as choosing the restaurant, and notice that relationships survive. When avoiding conflict, ask what the unspoken issue might cost later. Time alone, with a sketchbook or a long walk, can help them hear their own opinions beneath the voices of others. Finishing creative projects, not only starting them, builds confidence. Charm is a genuine gift, and it shines brightest when it carries their honest views rather than replacing them.

Within Gemini, decan 1 leans towards quicksilver curiosity, doubled and darting in every direction and decan 3 leans towards inventive, independent thinking that leaps ahead of its time. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: Why is the second decan of Gemini known for its charm?
faq.answer: Venus, the planet associated with Libra, is the sub-ruler of these middle degrees. It is traditionally read as adding grace, diplomacy and an appreciation of beauty to Gemini's curiosity, so these natives are often described as the sign's most sociable and partnership-minded members.

faq.question: What are the dates of Gemini decan 2?
faq.answer: In most years May 31 to June 10, the days when the Sun is between 10° and 19° of Gemini. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Gemini decan 2?
faq.answer: Venus. In the triplicity system each air sign's decans take the rulers of the air signs in order, starting with Gemini's own ruler, Mercury.
